text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Admiration is a burning longing—Vodka 
realized that. I, too, stand beyond the 
narrative I so passionately yearned for.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The God of Destruction descends upon the 
Japan Cup! Destined to meet the challenge 
is the fiery, free dancer!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Those with differing perspectives, and 
even my beloved nemesis! Is this decisive 
battle not a galaxy of shining giants?!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Then let the myriad orders shatter against 
my fleeting instant! I am the God of 
Destruction! The one who razes all, and 
guides all!
